description: Submit a signed open-position transaction. Re-verifies HMAC permit, re-reads pool/balances, re-simulates (sigVerify true, including the NFT-mint partial signature), then broadcasts. Pass signedTransaction plus permit, wallet, and the complete summary from lp_open_prepare, unchanged. If the wallet rewrote the message (Phantom Lighthouse / ComputeBudget), also pass unsignedTransaction from prepare. Returns signature and the new positionMint.

summary.description: Complete summary object from lp_open_prepare, unchanged (bound by the permit)

unsignedTransaction.description: Base64 prepared transaction from lp_open_prepare. Pass this when the wallet rewrote the message (Phantom Lighthouse / ComputeBudget).

name: lp_open_submit
title: Submit new position
